### ✨ What's New
#### 🍏 Core Improvements - iCloud Sync Overhaul: Deeply optimized the underlying logic to deliver a smoother, seamless synchronization experience. - Added Background Polling: Supports automatic silent background updates to keep data instantly synced across devices.
#### 🔮 Coming Soon - iOS Version Final Testing: The iOS application has entered its final testing phase! Smooth integration and seamless multi-device linkage with Mac are just around the corner. Stay tuned!

### ✨ 本次更新
#### 🐛 修复与优化 - 剪切面板：修复垂直剪切面板搜索框焦点被抢占问题。
### ✨ What's New
#### 🐛 Bug Fixes & Improvements - Clipping Panel: Fixed the issue where the focus of the search box in the vertical clipping panel was preempted.
